tools.name: agendapro_list_locations
tools.description: List the business's locations (sucursales / locales): id, name, address, phone, email, timezone, opening hours and country. Location ids are needed for bookings, slots and sales filters. GET /v3/locations.

tools.name: agendapro_get_location
tools.description: One location by id, with address, coordinates, timezone and weekly opening hours. GET /v3/locations/{id}.

tools.name: agendapro_list_services
tools.description: List the services (treatments, classes, sessions) the business offers: id, name, price, duration, type, category, whether online booking/payment is on, and the location. Service ids are needed to book. GET /v3/services.

tools.name: agendapro_get_service
tools.description: One service by id, including its category, images and the providers who perform it. GET /v3/services/{id}.

tools.name: agendapro_list_service_categories
tools.description: List service categories, ordered as the business arranges them. GET /v3/categories.

tools.name: agendapro_list_providers
tools.description: List service providers (the staff who take bookings): id, public name, location, active flag, online-booking flag and working hours. Provider ids are needed to book. GET /v3/providers.

tools.name: agendapro_get_provider
tools.description: One service provider by id, with biography, images and working hours including breaks. GET /v3/providers/{id}.

tools.name: agendapro_list_bookings
tools.description: List bookings (reservas / appointments) with time, status, service, provider, client id, location, price and the linked sale. AgendaPro requires at least ONE of client_id, location_id, service_id or service_provider_id; dates only narrow the result. A sale may be a membership covering several bookin

tools.name: agendapro_get_booking
tools.description: One booking by id with status, service, provider, client id, location, prices, notes and the linked sale. GET /v3/bookings/{id}.

tools.name: agendapro_list_available_slots
tools.description: Free booking time windows at a location on one date (optionally for one service and/or provider): start/end time, provider, plus a metadata summary (service duration, slot count). Use before creating a booking. GET /v3/available_slots.

tools.name: agendapro_create_booking
tools.description: WRITE: create a booking for an existing client, service, provider and location. Check agendapro_list_available_slots first. status_id must be a non-cancelled status: copy the status.id of an existing booking (agendapro_list_bookings). AgendaPro does NOT send email/SMS/WhatsApp notifications for book

tools.name: agendapro_update_booking
tools.description: WRITE: change an existing booking (partial update: only the fields you pass change): move it, switch service/provider/location, change status, price or notes. The merchant's customer policy applies: a change too close to the start time, or past the maximum number of changes, is refused with HTTP 422

tools.name: agendapro_cancel_booking
tools.description: WRITE: cancel a booking. This cannot be undone through the API. The merchant's customer policy applies: a cancellation that is disabled, too close to the start time or past the maximum number of changes is refused with HTTP 422 (tell the user the merchant does not allow it; do not retry). tools.name: agendapro_list_clients
tools.description: List the business's clients (customers) page by page: name, email, phone, identification number, address, birth date, record number, active flag. Personal data: only use it for the task at hand. To find one person use agendapro_search_clients. GET /v3/clients.

tools.name: agendapro_search_clients
tools.description: Find clients by free text (name, email, phone, identification number or record number): a short ranked list with id, full name, email, phone. The fastest way to get a client_id. GET /v3/clients/quick-search.

tools.name: agendapro_get_client
tools.description: One client by id with contact details, address, birth date, record number and active flag. GET /v3/clients/{id}.

tools.name: agendapro_list_client_custom_attributes
tools.description: The custom attribute values stored for one client (id, name, datatype, value). GET /v3/clients/{id}/custom_attributes.

tools.name: agendapro_list_custom_attributes
tools.description: The custom client fields the business defined (id, name, datatype, mandatory, group, choices). Use the template ids when setting custom_attributes on a client. GET /v3/custom_attributes.

tools.name: agendapro_create_client
tools.description: WRITE: create a new client. first_name is required and at least one of last_name, email or phone must also be given (AgendaPro's rule). Search first (agendapro_search_clients) to avoid duplicates; not idempotent. No message is sent to the client. POST /v3/clients.

tools.name: agendapro_update_client
tools.description: WRITE: change an existing client (partial update: only the fields you pass change; it overwrites the stored value). PATCH /v3/clients/{id}.

tools.name: agendapro_list_sales
tools.description: List sales (ventas): status (partially_paid, paid, canceled, refunded), paid and pending amounts, paid-at time, location, client id and the payment transactions. Filter by paid date range, location or client. GET /v3/sales.

tools.name: agendapro_get_sale
tools.description: One sale by id with amounts, status, location and its payment transactions (amount, paid-at, payment method). GET /v3/sales/{id}.

tools.name: agendapro_list_products
tools.description: List retail products in the catalog: name, SKU, price, active flag, category, brand and display. GET /v3/products.

tools.name: agendapro_get_product
tools.description: One catalog product by id with description, SKU, price, category, brand and display. GET /v3/products/{id}.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "agendapro_cancel_booking" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: WRITE: cancel a booking. This cannot be undone through the API. The merchant's customer policy applies: a cancellation that is disabled, too close to the start …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agendapro_list_locations, agendapro_create_booking, agendapro_list_clients, agendapro_search_clients, agendapro_create_client · Private data: agendapro_list_clients, agendapro_search_clients, agendapro_get_client · Public sink: agendapro_list_locations, agendapro_create_booking, agendapro_list_clients, agendapro_search_clients, agendapro_create_client.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agendapro_list_locations, agendapro_create_booking, agendapro_list_clients, agendapro_search_clients, agendapro_create_client · Private data: agendapro_list_clients, agendapro_search_clients, agendapro_get_client · Public sink: agendapro_list_locations, agendapro_create_booking, agendapro_list_clients, agendapro_search_clients, agendapro_create_client

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
